releaseName: Pixel-Perfect Auto Screen Calibration & Seamless Snug System Fit

highlights: Zero Excess Gap & Auto Snug Header: Eliminated status bar collision and forehead gap with native root insets and snug 52px app header
Screen Setting Analysis Engine: Automatically analyzes display dimensions, DPI scale, aspect ratio, and device category on launch
Proactive Microphone Permission Setup: On-startup calibration card requests microphone permissions cleanly for Cambridge IELTS speaking tests
Multi-Theme Solid Status Bar: Seamless status bar background matching dark (#161e2b) and light (#ffffff) themes with dynamic light/dark system icons
